title: Online Mutation Bihar – Parimarjan
organization: Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms Department
vacancyDetails: Online mutation correction and land record related application service in Bihar.
qualification: Applicants eligible under Bihar land record and mutation rules.
selectionProcess: Online application -> Revenue verification -> Mutation or correction update
documentsRequired: Sale deed or land document, identity, owner details and supporting revenue records.
howToApply: Open the official Parimarjan Bihar portal, select the required mutation or correction service and submit documents.
shortDescription: Bihar online mutation and Parimarjan land record correction service.
content:
Parimarjan Bihar provides online access to mutation and land record correction related services.

Keep valid land documents ready and track the application through the official portal or concerned revenue office.
